observations.value: No payment at booking; invoice after assessment and completed job; external card/BACS/PayPal payment using order reference.
Collection charge paid on booking and service balance after assessment.
Payment due on collection or delivery of cleaned items unless agreed otherwise.
FAQ describes two to three working days and an on-premises process.
Usually same day to 48 hours; a requested slot requires office confirmation.
Legacy wording says three shops; page branch details instead show Burbage, Earl Shilton and Nuneaton doorstep coverage.
Burbage and Earl Shilton are staffed; Queens Road Nuneaton is closed.

policies.text: A preferred date or slot is a request. Staff check the route and confirm by phone, WhatsApp or email before scheduling the driver.
Collections and deliveries run Monday to Friday. Saturday is shop drop-off only; Sunday is closed. Office confirmation remains necessary.
Cancellation before collection has no charge. Later cancellation charges are not specified.
Displayed prices are indicative; staff assess the actual items before confirming the service charge.
Later tariff changes do not alter orders already placed. Additional work costs are discussed with the customer before proceeding.
Record declared care needs, pre-existing condition, labels, sorted colours and advised temperatures. Staff may refuse unsuitable or hazardous items; no automatic suitability conclusion is generated.
Items must be ready and accessible for the agreed collection. Failed access may require rearrangement. Exact times are not guaranteed.
Commercial prices are bespoke by volume and frequency; collection/delivery included. Daily, weekly or fortnightly weekday schedules are offered; no minimum commercial order is stated.
Commercial and regular customers may have an individually agreed invoice arrangement. No automatic net terms or billing cadence is published.
The shop asks for a complaint within 48 hours of receipt and reviews it. A reclean, refund or credit is discretionary, recorded as an actual decision.
The published terms discuss items uncollected for over 90 days after notification. A workbench should retain notification and review records, not automatically dispose of property.
Wash Junkie records payments; it does not move money, process cards, implement refunds or replace accounting. External payment references can be recorded.
Keep the customer-facing Easy Laundry booking and Pay Your Bill tools; Wash Junkie currently has no customer app, public API or integrations.

issues.title: Current booking versus older payment wording
issues.required_choice: Keep source observations; use current booking workflow for the starter, allow a reasoned office override. Never charge the collection fee twice.

issues.title: Specialist partner and turnaround alternatives
issues.required_choice: Retain the current price-list partner week and the shorter FAQ claim. Use an actual promised date, not an unconditional calculation.

issues.title: Legacy three-shop wording
issues.required_choice: Starter has only two active shops; Nuneaton remains coverage.

issues.title: Load sizes and measured weights are different units
issues.required_choice: Never infer kg capacity for standard/large/XL. Record actual WDI and ironing weight; operator selects rounding if needed.

issues.title: Outer fee is up to £5
issues.required_choice: Require actual selected fee rather than treating the maximum as a fixed price.

issues.title: No published VAT/tax basis
issues.required_choice: Retain source £ totals and an explicitly reviewed tax setting. Do not silently add VAT or claim inclusive/exclusive status.

issues.title: Promotions need explicit eligibility and charge scope
issues.required_choice: The October 2026 duvet offer is 30%, excludes dry cleaning and cannot stack with any other offer. Keep actual order date and approved charge scope. First-order eligibility, wash-only scope and minimum ordering remain explicit choices.

issues.title: Downloadable tracker is not a native importer
issues.required_choice: Export a neutral copy of the published 12-column layout and source-linked richer files; do not claim one-click import.

"1. Delete the five example rows above and start typing your own.",,,,,,,,,,,
"2. Order ref: give every order a short code and write it on the bag. Letters plus digits beats a plain number - 'A1002' is harder to mishear on the phone than '1002'.",,,,,,,,,,,
"3. Status: keep to a short fixed list so you can filter. Suggested: Taken in / Sorting / In wash / Drying / Folding / Ready / Out for delivery / Collected.",,,,,,,,,,,
